_deploy_metadata.bootstrap_pattern: foundation-controlled. Treasury and Admin are the foundation deployer EOA; Platform, Operator, Guardian are fresh wallets generated at deploy time and stored at datachain-rope/contracts/.mapstore-keys/{platform,operator,guardian}.json with 0600 perms.
_deploy_metadata.migration_path: Mapstore agent rotates each role to a Mapstore-controlled multisig via AccessControl.grantRole + revokeRole, and updates the treasury via setPlatformTreasury. Sequence is documented in handover-from-rope-mapstore-escrow-live-2026-06-15.mdc. Contract is non-upgradeable; only role membership and treasury address change.
_deploy_metadata.key_handoff_to_mapstore: Platform key is required by Mapstore-vps (CRYPTO_PLATFORM_PRIVATE_KEY env). Operator and Guardian keys are held by foundation until Mapstore confirms their multisig setup; transferred via SSH-pipe when requested.
